name: How long do rental property turnaround repairs usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long do rental property turnaround repairs usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for rental turnover repairs generally ranges from two to seven business days depending on the scope of work. Minor cosmetic updates like drywall patching and interior touch-up paint can wrap up in two to three days. More extensive turnover jobs involving tile replacement, subfloor repairs, or multiple finish carpentry tasks usually take about a week. Landlords should secure material selections early to prevent vacancies from stretching out unnecessarily.
acceptedAnswer.description: Turnaround repairs typically take two to seven business days, depending on whether the unit requires quick paint and patch touch-ups or extensive tile and carpentry work.
